verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes a broad per-resource API reference covering authentication, parameters, invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports, errors and webhooks. It also provides an official Postman collection, which gives users runnable requests through an external tool. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-page try-it console. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, documented runnable examples within the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Postman experience.
